The '''Ione system''' was located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ione/Legends|Ione]].

==History==
The system contained the spaceport [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ione/Legends|Ione]], which had an indigenous population of about 1 billion.

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] and ''[[Stalker/Legends|Stalker]]'', temporarily detached from [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] as part of the search for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] new [[Echo Base/Legends|base]], dispatched a number of [[Viper probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] from the Ione system to nearby [[Allyuen/Legends|Allyuen]], [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and [[Tokmia/Legends|Tokmia]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref><ref name="TEA" />
